metas.name: 1. Undercover Burns
metas.description: Mr. Burns goes undercover as "Fred" at the nuclear power plant and becomes friends with Homer and the gang. Burns implements all sorts of amenities to improve his employees' lives, but a jealous Smithers plots to bring the old, bitter Burns back and destroy Fred.

metas.name: 2. I, Carumbus
metas.description: At a museum exhibit of Ancient Rome, Marge and Homer get into an argument about Homer's lack of ambition. They then imagine a Roman version of what would happen if Homer was more career-driven.

metas.name: 3. Now Museum, Now You Don't
metas.description: Lisa stays home from school to explore the wonders of Western art. She appears as Lisanardo, while Bart takes the shape of a French impressionist, Homer and Marge as Diego Rivera and Frida Kahlo, and Maggie as a warrior Cupid.

metas.name: 4. Treehouse of Horror XXXI
metas.description: The 31st annual Simpsons Halloween special includes a frightening look at the 2020 election, parodies of Toy Story and Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse and a 9th birthday Lisa just can't get over.

metas.name: 5. The 7 Beer Itch
metas.description: Homer is tempted by a British femme fatale while Marge and the kids are on a seaside vacation.

metas.name: 6. Podcast News
metas.description: Grampa Simpson is accused of a crime; Kent Brockman questions his career.

metas.name: 7. Three Dreams Denied
metas.description: Bart becomes a voice-over actor; Comic Book Guy is humiliated at Comic-Con; Lisa is set up for a fall.

metas.name: 8. The Road to Cincinnati
metas.description: Odd couple Skinner and Chalmers embark on an 800-mile car ride to Cincinnati to attend an administrator's convention - but can they reach their destination without killing each other first?

metas.name: 9. Sorry Not Sorry
metas.description: Lisa calls her teacher, Ms. Hoover, a hack and refuses to apologize. Then, she learns Ms. Hoover's private pain.

metas.name: 10. A Springfield Summer Christmas for Christmas
metas.description: A cable channel films a Christmas movie in Springfield and Skinner falls in love.

metas.name: 11. The Dad Feelings Limited
metas.description: Comic Book Guy and his wife Kumiko debate about having a baby and we learn about his awesome origin story.

metas.name: 12. Diary Queen
metas.description: Bart finds his old teacher's diary and learns a surprising secret. Then, Lisa discovers an even bigger surprise.

metas.name: 13. Wad Goals
metas.description: Bart becomes a successful caddy, but Marge worries it is ruining his character.

metas.name: 14. Yokel Hero
metas.description: Cletus becomes a singing sensation, while Homer becomes a new man. Then, Cletus turns on his fans, ruining everything.

metas.name: 15. Do Pizza Bots Dream of Electric Guitars
metas.description: Homer tries to reunite a mechanical band from his youth, but film and TV creator J.J. Abrams gets ahold of them first.

metas.name: 16. Manger Things
metas.description: A secret of Flanders' Past and a never-before-seen room of the Simpson house are shown off.

metas.name: 17. Uncut Femmes
metas.description: It is discovered that Chief Wiggum's wife is more than she seems. Meanwhile, Marge takes part in a jewel heist.

metas.name: 18. Burger Kings
metas.description: Mr. Burns gets into the plant-based burger business. Lisa refuses to believe he's up to no good.

metas.name: 19. Panic on the Streets of Springfield
metas.description: Lisa gets a new imaginary friend - a depressed British singer from the 1980s. Meanwhile, Homer becomes a truck guy.

metas.name: 20. Mother and Child Reunion
metas.description: Lisa makes a shocking college decision, wounding Marge. It leads to a very surprising place.

metas.name: 21. The Man from G.R.A.M.P.A.
metas.description: A British secret agent comes to Springfield in search of a Russian spy.

metas.name: 22. The Last Barfighter
metas.description: After Moe breaks their most sacred rule, a secret society of bartenders seeks ultimate vengeance on Homer and his friends.
